name: The Wheel of Time
description: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever. They must choose whether to trust this stranger – and each other – with the fate of the world before the Dark One breaks out of His prison, and the Last Battle begins.

videos.title: Origin Stories - The Breaking of the World
videos.overview: See how the male side of the One Power was poisoned by the Dark One and brought about the destruction of the world.

videos.title: "Look Inside" Episode 1

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 1 (ft Marcus Rutherford)
videos.overview: In the inaugural episode of the official The Wheel of Time after-show, The Dusty Wheel’s Matt Hatch welcomes actor Marcus Rutherford to talk about his portrayal of Perrin Aybara. Then, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episodes 1-3, shares their thoughts on where the series is headed, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content.

videos.title: Origin Stories - Saidin, Saidar, Stone
videos.overview: A lesson on the difference between the male and female side of channeling and the darkness that separated the two.

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 2 (ft Zoë Robins)
videos.overview: Matt Hatch welcomes actor Zoë Robins to talk about her portrayal of Two Rivers Wisdom Nynaeve al'Meara. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 4 - Logain’s story, the Aes Sedai, and if Mat is someone who can be trusted. Plus - more exclusive behind-the-scenes content.

videos.title: Origin Stories - The White Tower
videos.overview: An Aes Sedai takes us through the White Tower to learn about her sisters from the various Ajah's.

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 3 (ft Isis Mussenden)
videos.overview: Matt Hatch welcomes Costume Designer Isis Mussenden to chat about how she and her team created the look of the show’s unique costumes. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 5 - Whitecloaks torture two of our heroes, a fan favorite Ogier is introduced, and shockwaves reverberate through the White Tower.

videos.title: Origin Stories - An Ogier’s Longing
videos.overview: The story of an Ogier treesings his stedding into the world and takes us on a journey through time to understand the lives they lead.

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 4 (ft Daniel Henney)
videos.overview: Daniel Henney joins Matt to talk about stepping into the boots of Lan Mandragoran. Also, the Inside the Wheel of Time panel breaks down Episode 6 - White Tower politics lead to Moiraine’s exile, our Two Rivers friends are reunited, and the Dark One stirs at the Eye of the World.

videos.title: "Look Inside" Episode 7
videos.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 7 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 5 (ft Nick Dudman & Julian Parry)
videos.overview: Matt and the panel break down Episode 7 of The Wheel of Time - an epic battle on the slopes of Dragonmount, the group escapes the Black Wind, and Min shares her viewings. Then we go behind the scenes and speak to Make-Up Effects Designer Nick Dudman and Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Parry for exclusive interviews about how the world of The Wheel of Time was created.

videos.title: "Look Inside" Episode 8
videos.overview: Delve deeper into Ep 8 with exclusive behind the scenes interviews with cast and crew.

videos.title: Inside the Wheel of Time: Episode 6 (ft Madeleine Madden)
videos.overview: We break down the Season One finale of The Wheel of Time. Matt is joined by Madeleine Madden and other special guests. Egwene and Nynaeve unlock their power,  Trollocs march into battle, and Rand faces a showdown with the Dark One. Plus exclusive behind the scenes content about the making of the world of The Wheel of Time.

videos.title: The Making of the Winternight Sequence
videos.overview: The Winternight Sequence is one of the wildest scenes in Wheel of Time, see how the cast and crew worked their magic and brought this scene to the screen.

videos.title: Leavetaking
videos.overview: A strange noblewoman arrives in a remote mountain village, claiming one of five youths is the reincarnation of an ancient power who once destroyed the world – and will do so again, if she’s not able to discover which of them it is. But they all have less time than they think.

videos.title: Shadow's Waiting
videos.overview: Moiraine and Lan lead the four villagers to safety, unsure which is the one from the prophecy. But the friends are equally unsure about their rescuers, especially once they see how far Moiraine is willing to go for her mission – and how far astray Lan is willing to lead them.

videos.title: A Place of Safety
videos.overview: Moiraine and Lan find help in an unexpected – and unwanted – quarter, as the separated villagers try to find their way back to each other, or at least to refuge. But they all soon learn how far the Dark One’s reach extends, and how few they can trust on the road.

videos.title: The Dragon Reborn
videos.overview: Moiraine struggles with uncertainty while Lan struggles with their new companion. Rand wonders about Mat and Mat starts to wonder at himself. Egwene and Perrin take their first steps down a different path. An incredible new power is unleashed on the world.

videos.title: Blood Calls Blood
videos.overview: Perrin and Egwene run into a familiar face. Mat and Rand see strange ones. Moiraine and Lan mourn their loss.

videos.title: The Flame of Tar Valon
videos.overview: Moiraine faces the consequences of her actions. Mat faces the darkness in himself. Egwene faces the most powerful woman in the world.

videos.title: The Dark Along the Ways
videos.overview: Moiraine and her charges are diverted from their path by an unexpected encounter. This diversion, though, reveals many things — Moiraine’s true goal, Lan’s past, the fractures that have grown in the group, and the identity of the Dragon Reborn.

videos.title: The Eye of the World
videos.overview: For twenty years, Moiraine has dreamed and worked towards this moment. But she can't stop the Dragon Reborn from seeing the appeal of the Dark.

videos.title: A Taste of Solitude
videos.overview: Moiraine, Lan, Nynaeve, Egwene, Perrin, and Mat find themselves more alone than ever.

videos.title: Strangers and Friends
videos.overview: The Two Rivers youths forge new relationships, while Lan tries to mend an old one.

videos.title: What Might Be
videos.overview: Nynaeve faces her greatest fears. Rand seeks guidance on his powers from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Daughter of the Night
videos.overview: Moiraine searches for Rand while Nynaeve mourns her losses.

videos.title: Damane
videos.overview: Moiraine and Rand flee for their lives. Egwene and Nynaeve encounter a new foe.

videos.title: Eyes Without Pity
videos.overview: Rand makes a risky alliance and Egwene gathers her strength to confront the horror of her circumstances.

videos.title: Daes Dae'Mar
videos.overview: A familiar face foils Moiraine and Rand's plans.

videos.title: What Was Meant to Be
videos.overview: Fate leads Rand and the others to an inevitable showdown with their most formidable enemies yet.

videos.title: To Race the Shadow
videos.overview: Chaos erupts within the White Tower as our heroes become targets of a new evil.

videos.title: A Question of Crimson
videos.overview: A dangerous visitor comes to the White Tower. Perrin returns home. Rand and Egwene forge their own path under Moiraine’s watchful eye.

videos.title: Seeds of Shadow
videos.overview: Nynaeve and Elayne are given a deadly mission. Perrin learns the consequences of his rage. Lanfear begins to play a dangerous game.

videos.title: The Road to the Spear
videos.overview: Rand faces the forgotten history of his family as Moiraine learns the devastating truth of her future.

videos.title: Tel'aran'rhiod
videos.overview: Egwene learns Rand's dark secret. Perrin stages a daring rescue. Nynaeve, Elayne, Mat, and Min hunt the Black Ajah.

videos.title: The Shadow in the Night
videos.overview: Tensions flare between Egwene and Rand. Moiraine and Lan come to terms with their destiny.

videos.title: Goldeneyes
videos.overview: Perrin begins to embrace his role as a leader among the people of the Two Rivers.

videos.title: He Who Comes with the Dawn
videos.overview: Nynaeve, Elayne, Mat, and Min confront the Black Ajah and their futures. Moiraine and Lan prepare to face their fate. Rand and Egwene set their destinies in motion.
